regime_context: Detector shows a narrow, two-theme leadership structure: Banks (rank 1, crowded, high durability) just ahead of Innovative Pharma & CXO (rank 2, also crowded), with only 4 of 22 themes trend-eligible — and the rotation margin is razor-thin (0.01). Critically, the absolute-trend gate did NOT reduce drawdown on this market's history (gate_helps false), so the only validated edge is absent here; momentum rank carries no predictive weight, and track record shows directional accuracy of only 0.377 on 77 calls. This is a low-conviction, falsifiable-lean-only desk note.
emerging_watch: AI Compute & Optics (rank 3, trend-eligible false but hurst_tag trend) is the highest-ranked candidate not yet eligible; watch whether it flips to eligible while remaining above Pharma in rank — the observable that would retire this watch is 515000.SS confirming eligibility with breadth above 0.3 and the rank overtaking Innovative Pharma & CXO.

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks are the prevailing narrative with the highest durability_bar (0.73), broadest breadth (0.889), and trend-eligibility — but this is a leader-recognition call, not a return forecast. The rank/gate legs give no alpha here (rank-IC ~0, gate unhelpful on this tape); the only rationale for an overweight is that fading a confirmed leader is the documented failure mode, so the safe directional default is to stay with the leader rather than rotate against it. Crowding is flagged (z 1.78) as a size-down caution only.
evidence: crowding_z 1.78 + crowded=true (sizing caution, not a fade)
theses.dissent: Banks are crowded and the durability read is coincident, not forward-looking; on a mean-reverting A-share tape where the trend gate has no drawdown edge, leadership can reverse sharply with no warning and high crowding amplifies drawdown risk.

falsifier.text: 512800.SS lags CSI 300 by 5% or more by 2026-10-28

theses.subject: Innovative Pharma & CXO
theses.thesis: Pharma & CXO is the confirmed challenger, a hair behind Banks (margin 0.01) and also trend-eligible with solid durability (0.60). The rotation read shows no confirmed handoff, but the structure is a two-theme leadership pair rather than a one-narrative monopoly; an equal-direction lean on the challenger is justified only as a diversified expression within leadership, not as a rotation-timing call (rotation has no validated forward edge).
theses.dissent: The challenger could simply be coincident strength; with rotation timing unvalidated and both leaders crowded, this may be late-cycle participation that reverses together with Banks in any broad de-risking.

falsifier.text: 159992.SZ lags CSI 300 by 5% or more by 2026-10-28

theses.subject: Coal
theses.thesis: Coal is trend-eligible but tagged mean-revert with mediocre durability (0.46) and thin breadth (0.30). With the absolute-trend gate unhelpful on this market and no rank alpha, there is no positive case for an overweight; the mean-revert tag and non-trend structure argue for staying out.
theses.dissent: Coal could be an early value/reflation rotation beneficiary if cyclical leadership broadens, and low crowding leaves room for inflows.
